Package index

Package

An overview of the package, its classes and its workflow.

WithinHostExperiment-package
WithinHostExperiment: Within-Host Pathogen Variant QC, Diversity, and Bottleneck

Classes

The container for within-host variant calls, the filter that QC applies to it, the rule technical replicates must meet, and the site frequency spectrum built from the calls.

show(<WithinHostExperiment>) `[`(<WithinHostExperiment>,<ANY>,<ANY>,<ANY>)
WithinHostExperiment: Container for within-host pathogen variant data
show(<ISNVFilter>)
ISNVFilter: Quality control filter for iSNV analysis
show(<ConcordanceRule>)
ConcordanceRule: agreement required between technical replicates
show(<WithinHostSFS>)
WithinHostSFS: Site Frequency Spectrum for within-host variants

Import and conversion

Build the container from VCF files, variant tables or Bioconductor objects, combine objects, and convert back.

WithinHostExperiment()
Create a WithinHostExperiment from components
readWithinHost()
Import iSNV data from VCF files
readWithinHostTable()
Import iSNV data from tabular files
coerce-WHE coerce,WithinHostExperiment,data.frame-method coerce,WithinHostExperiment,VRanges-method coerce,VRanges,WithinHostExperiment-method coerce,VCF,WithinHostExperiment-method
Convert between WithinHostExperiment, data.frame, VRanges and VCF
combineRows(<WithinHostExperiment>) combineCols(<WithinHostExperiment>)
Combine WithinHostExperiment objects by rows or columns
example_whe
Example WithinHostExperiment dataset

Accessors

The QC audit log, the filters applied, the calls that passed, and the transmission pairs described by the sample metadata.

qcLog() qcFilters() passedISNV() transmissionPairs() `qcLog<-`() `qcFilters<-`()
Access the QC audit log

Quality control

Choose filters and flag, without deleting, calls that fail depth, frequency, strand, primer or replicate criteria; report likely cross-contamination and summarise what QC removed.

ISNVFilter()
Create an ISNVFilter object
ConcordanceRule()
Create a ConcordanceRule object
adaptiveFilter()
Create a technology-appropriate ISNVFilter
flagISNV()
Flag iSNV sites based on quality criteria
flagPrimerSites()
Flag iSNVs in primer binding regions
flagReplicateDiscordance()
Flag iSNVs with replicate discordance
sciStrandBias()
Strand Coverage Imbalance (SCI) score
flagStrandBiasSCI()
Flag strand-biased iSNVs using the SCI metric
detectCrossContamination()
Detect potential cross-contamination between samples
qcSummary()
Generate a QC summary report

Annotation

Label sites with genes and with the codon and amino acid change each substitution makes.

annotateGenes()
Label variant sites with the genes they overlap
annotateCodonChange()
Codon and amino acid consequence of each SNV

Diversity

Per-sample diversity indices, their comparison between groups, a plausibility check, and a model of diversity against covariates.

calcDiversity()
Compute within-host diversity indices
compareDiversity()
Compare diversity between sample groups
checkDiversityPlausibility()
Check diversity estimates against heuristic plausibility ranges
shannonISNV()
Shannon entropy from iSNV frequencies
piISNV()
Nucleotide diversity (pi) from iSNV frequencies
wattersonISNV()
Watterson's theta from iSNV count
simpsonISNV()
Simpson diversity index for iSNV frequencies
chao1ISNV()
Chao1 richness estimator for iSNV data
fitDiversityModel()
Fit a linear model to diversity data

Site frequency spectrum

Bin allele frequencies into a spectrum, correct it for the detection threshold, compare spectra and compute statistics from one.

buildSFS()
Build a site frequency spectrum from a WithinHostExperiment
buildSFSList()
Build SFS for all samples in a WithinHostExperiment
correctSFSBias()
Correct ascertainment bias in the within-host SFS
compareSFS()
Compare two within-host SFS objects
neutralityFromSFS()
Compute all neutrality statistics from a WithinHostSFS

Neutrality and selection

Tajima’s D and Fu’s Fs, the within-host pN/pS ratio, consensus sequences for between-host dN/dS, and selection coefficients from frequency change.

calcNeutralityTests()
Compute neutrality test statistics
tajimaD()
Tajima's D statistic
fusFs()
Fu's Fs statistic
pNpSWithinHost()
Within-host pN/pS ratio
consensusSequences()
Consensus sequence of each sample
estimateSelectionCoefficient()
Estimate selection coefficient from frequency trajectory

Transmission

Shared and private variants of a donor-recipient pair, bottleneck size estimates, and exports for other bottleneck tools.

calcSharedVariants()
Calculate shared variant statistics
quickBottleneck()
Quick bottleneck size estimation (beta-binomial approximate MLE)
exactBottleneck()
Exact bottleneck size estimation
exportPairFrequencies()
Export donor-recipient frequency table
asViralBottleneckInput()
Export data for ViralBottleneck package

Longitudinal

Follow variant frequencies through the samples of one host over time, and flag sites seen at too few timepoints.

trackFrequency()
Track variant frequency trajectories over time
detectEmergingVariants()
Detect emerging variants across time points
flagTemporalInconsistency()
Flag temporally inconsistent iSNVs in longitudinal data

Multi-caller

Combine and compare the calls of several variant callers on the same samples.

consensusISNV()
Multi-caller consensus iSNV detection
calcCallerConcordance()
Pairwise caller concordance matrix
benchmarkCallers()
Benchmark variant callers against truth or each other

Statistics

Permutation tests and multiple-testing correction for the summaries above.

permutationTest()
Permutation test for two-group comparison
multitestCorrection()
Multiple testing correction for p-values

Visualisation

Frequency spectra of an object or of WithinHostSFS objects, donor-recipient scatter plots, a QC dashboard and frequency trajectories.

plotFrequencySpectrum()
Plot iSNV frequency spectrum
plotPairScatter()
Plot donor-recipient frequency scatter
plotQCDashboard()
QC dashboard plot
plotSFS()
Plot a within-host site frequency spectrum
plotFrequencyTrajectory()
Plot allele frequency trajectories over time
